name: provision-api
description: Backend API for provisioning-related workflows and configuration setup. Likely owns endpoints for account provisioning, service setup, and provisioning state changes.

name: notification-api
description: Backend API for browser, email, and SMS notifications. Owns endpoints related to notification delivery, notification preferences, and notification-triggering workflows.

name: upload-api
description: Backend API for file upload workflows, especially uploading files to cloud storage. Owns endpoints for upload requests, file transfer initiation, and storage-related upload operations.

name: lead-ingestion-api
description: Backend API for HTTP lead ingestion. Owns endpoints that receive, validate, and ingest incoming lead data from external systems or integrations.

name: recents-api
description: Backend API for recent activity data related to users and accounts. Owns endpoints for recent events, activity feeds, and recently accessed or changed entities.

name: call-history-api
description: Backend API for customer call history, call notes, call tags, and tag categories. Owns endpoints for retrieving call records and managing call metadata.

name: products-api
description: Backend API for customer products. Owns endpoints related to product data, product availability, product configuration, and customer-product relationships and invoices.

name: pbx-config-api
description: Backend API for PBX and VoIP configuration. Owns endpoints for phone system settings, PBX configuration data, and telephony-related configuration management.

name: custom-fields-api
description: Backend API for custom fields used in the UI. Owns endpoints for defining, retrieving, and managing dynamic or user-configurable fields across the product.

name: crm-api
description: Backend API for CRM entities such as leads, contacts(persons), opportunities, pipelines, and account relationship data.

name: call-api
description: Backend API for initiating VoIP-related actions over HTTP. Owns endpoints that trigger calls or telephony events rather than historical call records.

name: text-api
description: Backend API for SMS and MMS messaging. Owns endpoints for sending text messages, media messages, and messaging-related workflows.

name: favorites-api
description: Backend API for user favorites. Owns endpoints for storing, retrieving, and managing favorited entities or user-pinned items.

name: user-api
description: Backend API for user data, user profiles, account-level user information, and user-related operations.

name: workflows-api
description: Backend API for workflow-related backend logic. Owns endpoints for workflow execution, workflow configuration, and workflow-driven automation behavior.

name: calendar-api
description: Backend API for calendar integrations and calendar OAuth flows. Owns endpoints for calendar auth, integration setup, and calendar-connected workflows.

name: automation-api
description: Backend API for automation-related features and execution. Likely owns endpoints for automation definitions, triggers, rules, and automation state management.

name: notification-worker
description: Background worker for notification processing and delivery. Does not define primary backend endpoints.

name: products-worker
description: Background worker for product-related processing. Does not define primary backend endpoints.
